response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI systems in fintech, regulatory compliance experience, or leadership scaling teams beyond 10 people — critical gaps for a CTO role requiring deep fintech-AI infrastructure ownership.
strengths: Exposure to agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven full-stack and systems engineering across high-throughput environments
Active open-source contributions and technical communication skills
concerns: No clear evidence of building or operating multi-agent AI systems in production fintech
Lacks demonstrated experience with regulated financial systems or compliance infrastructure
No track record of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or leading senior technical leadership layers
